newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Datacraft wins $2.9 mln Mongolia deal.
newsitem.headline: Datacraft wins $2.9 mln Mongolia deal.

text.p: Telecommunications and network systems company, Datacraft Asia Ltd, said on Monday it had won a US$2.9 million contract from the Inner Mongolia Data Communications Bureau for a digital data network (DDN) to link six cities in northern China.
Installation work on the project had already begun and would be completed by the end of the year, the company said in a statement.
Datacraft Asia said the contract followed a US$800,000 pilot DDN project implemented by its subsidiary company, Datacraft China, two years ago.
The statement said the network would provide business communications connections to the cities of Chifeng, Wuhai, Jining, Tongliao, Dongsheng and Xilinhaote.
